data.name: Swarnimika
data.gender_notes: Swarnimika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Swarnimika is a beautiful and divine name derived from Sanskrit. It is composed of two words - Swarni and Mika, where Swarni means golden and Mika means lotus. Swarnimika is considered a symbol of purity, beauty, and strength. In Hindu mythology, the lotus is a sacred flower that blooms even in muddy waters, representing the divine ability to rise above adversity and remain pure.

data.etymology: Swarnimika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Golden Lotus.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Swarnimika total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
